predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Levante vs Elche: Expected Goals (xG), Defensive Fragility & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Quantitative expectancy and venue-split defensive metrics support Elche avoiding defeat (Draw / Away Win) in a high-tempo contest projected for Over 2.5 goals and BTTS: Yes.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Draw / Away Win anchored by 61.4% Poisson X2 mass and Elche's 5-in-6 away unbeaten record (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Secondary Angle: Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS: Yes supported by 2.96 combined lambda and 3.68 combined xGA/match (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Contingency Angle: 1:1 Scoreline hedge covering the 11.3% modal Poisson cell if 60.9% big-chance waste caps finishing (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Levante's zero home clean sheets test Elche's resilient away attack.

spf.comment: Retains both an Elche 1:2 away victory and a 1:1 draw because Elche hold 61.4% combined Poisson probability and superior xGA, while a single Away Win call ignores both sides' 60.9% chance-waste rate.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.96 combined lambda, 56.8% Poisson Over 2.5 probability, 3.68 combined xGA per match, and four of five Levante home games clearing 2.5.

btts.comment: Driven by Levante's zero clean sheets in five home fixtures (1.99 xGA/match) and Elche scoring in five of six away outings against a 1.69 xGA defense.

score.comment: 1:2 captures Elche's edge in forward threat and defensive prevention in an open exchange, while 1:1 covers the 11.3% modal Poisson stalemate.

goals.comment: 3 goals aligns with the 2.96 lambda and Over 2.5 projection, with 2 goals covering the tight 22.7% Poisson runner-up branch if conversion lags.

bqc.comment: Loss-Loss reflects Levante trailing at half-time in 60% of home games and Elche's 100% away win conversion from half-time leads, while Draw-Draw covers Elche's 2-for-2 away half-time draw holds.
